1580-4050-8347.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

240-1849-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

512-1336-1432.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-1432.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-1432.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1545-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

413-1011-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
413-1011-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-1011-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

2653-2893-5478-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-1090-2417.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-2417.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-4125-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4125-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-4125-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4125-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4091-5168-7791.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{R}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Bloom Tender.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

215-4742-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4742-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3755-4742-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-4742-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4742-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-7741.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Shang-Chi.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-7741.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

4149-4599-4871-6019-7297.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-7297.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

1374-3626-4742-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-4742-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

628-6797-7194.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-5070.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-1879-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1236-2018-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-5641-5789.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-2079-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2079-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

225-4772-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-4772-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-4772-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 4 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

618-3662-4836-4872.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
618-3662-4836-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2-1770-2744-5043-5296.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger twice.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the Faerie from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Workhorse four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

824-2464-3430.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2464-3430.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.

643-3850.description: Activate Realmbreaker's second ability by paying {10}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Praetors due to Maskwood Nexus, and put them onto the battlefield.

594-2034-3394.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
594-2034-3394.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
The Crab dies, triggering Weatherlight Compleated, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

224-391-3470-4967.notablePrerequisites: Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
224-391-3470-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

1627-2205-4050-4275.notablePrerequisites: Imperious Perfect and Llanowar Elves do not have summoning sickness.
1627-2205-4050-4275.description:
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Imperious Perfect by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding one mana of any color.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Faces of the Past, untapping all Elves and Warriors.
Repeat.

1937-3593-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Weatherseed Treefolk from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Weatherseed Treefolk, adding {R}.
Weatherseed Treefolk dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1777-3905.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Unbreakable Bond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1465-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-5147.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2510-2556-3573.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2510-2556-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

420-1041.description:
Cast Worms of the Earth.
Cast Aegis Angel, and when Aegis Angel ETBs, target Worms of the Earth.
Player's can not play lands or have lands enter the battlefield, and paying the cost to remove Worms of the Earth does not destroy it due to Aegis Angel.
